steam.store_details: Delisted from Steam in December 2022, when Epic pulled the entire classic Unreal series from sale. OldUnreal (oldunreal.com) distributes a free, Epic-authorized copy of the full game. Flathub's launcher for this game is a separate, actively-changing package, not necessarily the same build.
steam.patches: OldUnreal's patches add a selectable OpenAL-based 'ALAudio' renderer — a strong alternative if you'd rather use it than this script's approach.

audio_fixes.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_fixes.reason: UT2004 ships with EAX and 3D sound off and loads its bundled DefOpenAL32.dll instead of OpenAL32.dll. In the game's options, this is Audio Mode 'H/W 3D + EAX' with System Driver ticked.
